item.title: NASDAQ forecast: Is Nasdaq topping out? All-time highs or now?
item.description: The Nasdaq’s recent rally has been impressive, but the index is now confronting the same premium zone that triggered a sell-off earlier.

item.title: AUD/USD consolidates below mid-0.6600s; bulls await Fed decision amid RBA's hawkish tilt
item.description: The AUD/USD pair is seen consolidating its recent strong gains to the highest level since September 18, touched the previous day, and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses through the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 104.00 as overbought RSI caps upside potential
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross loses traction to around 104.00, snapping the six-day winning streak during the early European session on Wednesday. Deeper-than-expected producer deflation data from China undermines the China-proxy Australian Dollar (AUD) against the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: Gold consolidates above $4,200 as traders seem reluctant ahead of FOMC rate decision
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on the previous day's bounce from the $4,170 area, or a one-week low, and oscillates in a range near the weekly top, touched during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: GBP/USD holds positive ground above 1.3300, eyes on Fed rate decision
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades on a firmer note around 1.3305 during the early European session on Wednesday. The Greenback edges lower against the Pound Sterling (GBP) as the US Federal Reserve (Fed) is widely expected to announce another interest rate cut on Wednesday.

item.title: USD/CHF flattens around 0.8050 as investors await Fed’s policy outcome
item.description: The USD/CHF pair trades flat around 0.8060 during the late Asian trading session on Wednesday. The Swiss Franc pair consolidates as investors await the monetary policy announcement by the Federal Reserve (Fed), which is scheduled at 19:00 GMT.

item.title: Japanese Yen struggles to build on intraday gains as traders await Fed decision
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) sticks to modest intraday gains that followed the release of Japan’s Corporate Goods Price Index, which exceeded expectations and reaffirmed bets for an imminent rate hike by the Bank of Japan (BoJ).

item.title: US President Donald Trump plans final round of Fed Chair interviews in coming days — WSJ
item.description: US President Donald Trump plans to begin his final round of interviews in the coming days with candidates to be the next Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing senior administration officials.

item.title: Where LPL financial sees the S&P 500 at the end of 2026
item.description: n its 2026 outlook, LPL Financial (NASDAQ:LPLA) sees modest gains for the S&P 500 next year.
